quests.title: Fairy Godmother - Snow Hill Recommendation Sticker
quests.prereqText: Level 170+, have completed Little Chagan - Read Chagan's Dream
steps: Talk to Fairy Godmother at Snow Hill Town - Laplanoel.

Get 14x Snow Hill Sticker: Snow Hill sticker quests: 22 Snow Hill quests (Ancient Polar Bear, Dorothy, Farmer Tsetsech, Frog Shaman, General Granada, Genius Cochma, Grandma / Grandpa Tango, Horse Hiddink, Lethos, Lifeguard Deen, Louis Bitton, Old Artist, Poppuri, Prince Stephano, Princess Rosetta, Santa Claus, Tacky, Tango, Witch La Befana).
Get 1x Adventurer's Book: reward from Little Chagan - Interpret Chagan's Dream.
Bring everything back to Fairy Godmother.

source.from: Snow Hill sticker quests: 22 Snow Hill quests (Ancient Polar Bear, Dorothy, Farmer Tsetsech, Frog Shaman, General Granada, Genius Cochma, Grandma / Grandpa Tango, Horse Hiddink, Lethos, Lifeguard Deen, Louis Bitton, Old Artist, Poppuri, Prince Stephano, Princess Rosetta, Santa Claus, Tacky, Tango, Witch La Befana)
Reward from Little Chagan - Interpret Chagan's Dream

quests.notes: Snow Hill Sticker comes from that area's sticker quests (see the source on the item). Adventurer's Book is obtained by completing Little Chagan - Read Chagan's Dream.

quests.title: Witch La Befana - Broken Promise
quests.prereqText: Level 170+, have Save the Snow Machine in quest log
steps: Talk to Witch La Befana at Snow Hill Town - Laplanoel.
Get 1x Truth Draught: reward from Fairy Godmother - Truth Draught.
Get 1x Ice Heart: reward from Fairy Godmother - Truth Draught.
Bring everything back to Witch La Befana.

source.from: Reward from Fairy Godmother - Truth Draught
Reward from Fairy Godmother - Truth Draught

quests.notes: Truth Draught and Ice Heart are obtained by completing Fairy Godmother - Truth Draught.

quests.title: Fairy Godmother - Truth Draught
quests.prereqText: Level 170, have Witch La Befana - Broken Promise in quest log
steps: Talk to Fairy Godmother at Snow Hill Town - Laplanoel.
Get 1x Blue Orchid: Drilled in Snow Hill Fields.
Get 1x Udambara: Drilled in Snow Hill Fields.
Bring everything back to Fairy Godmother.

source.from: Drilled in Snow Hill Fields (drill depth not on the wiki)
Drilled in Snow Hill Fields (drill depth not on the wiki)

quests.title: Santa Claus (2) - Save the Snow Machine
quests.prereqText: Level 170+, have completed Witch La Befana - Broken Promise
steps: Talk to Santa Claus (2) at Laplanoel - Santa's Post Office.
Get 1x Broken Remote: dropped by Giant Coolem (Lv.277) in Ice Dungeon 4 - Teardrop Walkways.
Get 1x Remote Part A: dropped by Great Coolem (Lv.280) in Ice Dungeon 3 - Heart of Crystal / 4 - Teardrop Walkways.
Get 1x Remote Part B: dropped by Freyr (Lv.259) in Ice Dungeon 1 - Cave of Darkblue / 2 - Cave of Crystal.
Get 1x Remote Part C: dropped by Freyja (Lv.264) in Ice Dungeon 1 - 3.
Bring everything back to Santa Claus (2).

source.map: Ice Dungeon 3 - Heart of Crystal / 4 - Teardrop Walkways
Ice Dungeon 1 - Cave of Darkblue / 2 - Cave of Crystal

quests.notes: Broken Remote is dropped by Giant Coolem (Lv.277), Remote Part A is dropped by Great Coolem (Lv.280), Remote Part B is dropped by Freyr (Lv.259) and Remote Part C is dropped by Freyja (Lv.264).

quests.title: Santa Claus (2) - Fix the Remote Control
steps: Talk to Santa Claus (2) at Laplanoel - Santa's Post Office.
Get 1x Fixed Remote: Inventor Gale: Satisfaction Guarantee + Broken Remote + Remote Part A + B + C (all handed back by Save the Snow Machine).
Bring everything back to Santa Claus (2).

source.from: Inventor Gale: Satisfaction Guarantee + Broken Remote + Remote Part A + B + C (all handed back by Save the Snow Machine)

quests.notes: Fixed Remote is obtained by compounding Satisfaction Guarantee + Broken Remote + Remote Part A + Remote Part B + Remote Part C with Inventor Gale at Gate of Snow Hill. Satisfaction Guarantee, Broken Remote, Remote Part A, Remote Part B, Remote Part C are obtained by completing Santa Claus (2) - Save the Snow Machine.
